lede: The biggest action this week happens Wednesday when the Town's Planning and Zoning Commission takes up the Carhenge Redevelopment Project — a preliminary large-scale subdivision on Town-owned land at 700 W Pacific Ave — alongside other Town-initiated development proposals in the Accommodations 2 zone. Thursday, SMART's board votes on two vendor contracts central to the gondola structural analysis work, which is about as consequential as regional transit decisions get. Council also convenes Sunday for a public hearing on a liquor permit for KOTO's Live at the Drive event.

notable.stake: Town votes on Carhenge lot consolidation and other Town-owned development concepts.
SMART votes to award two gondola structural analysis contracts — key bridge-or-bust step.
Public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive liquor permit — residents may comment.
